description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'SingleWaiterAutoResetEvent' implementing a synchronization primitive for signaling and waiting with support for a single waiter, utilizing async/await patterns and low-level thread synchronization.

classes.name: SingleWaiterAutoResetEvent
classes.description: A synchronization event that automatically resets after signaling, supporting a single waiter at a time, designed for use in asynchronous programming scenarios.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Signals the wait event, waking the waiter if present.

methods.name: WaitAsync
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask that completes when the event is signaled; supports a single concurrent waiter.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the wait source.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Schedules a continuation to run when the wait source completes.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Completes the wait operation and resets the wait source.
